intro: How to talk about proportions and percentages, and how to compare two equal things.
p.la mayoría de.consejo: It goes with «de» and a group: «la mayoría de los jóvenes». The verb can be singular or plural.
p.la mitad de.consejo: It is feminine: «la mitad». The final d is soft: mi-TAD.
p.un tercio de.consejo: You can also say «la tercera parte». The c sounds th in Spain: TER-thyo.
p.una cuarta parte de.consejo: You can also say «un cuarto». «Parte» is feminine, that is why it is «cuarta».
p.por ciento.consejo: You say «el veinte por ciento» and write «20 %». The c sounds th in Spain: THYEN-to.
p.casi todos.consejo: «Casi» goes first: «casi todos», «casi nunca». It means «close to, but not quite».
p.muy pocos.consejo: With people: «muy pocos», «muy pocas». With uncountable things: «muy poco».
p.uno de cada tres.consejo: With a group of women: «una de cada tres». The word «cada» does not change.
p.igual de.consejo: It is used with an adjective or adverb and «que»: «igual de alto que su padre».
p.encuesta.consejo: A survey is given to many people. The u is pronounced: en-KWES-ta.
p.según.consejo: It shows the source: «según la encuesta». The accent marks the stress: se-GUN.
p.aumentar.consejo: The opposite is «disminuir». A number, a price or an amount increases.
b1.texto:
- **La mayoría de** + group: la mayoría de los jóvenes. The verb can be singular (**vive**) or plural (**viven**).
- **Fractions:** la mitad de, un tercio de, una cuarta parte de.
- **Percentages:** el veinte por ciento de los alumnos.
- **Uno de cada tres** = one in every three. Also: **casi todos**, **muy pocos**, **nadie**.

To compare two equal things: **igual de** + adjective + **que**: es **igual de** alto **que** su padre. To name the source: **según** la encuesta.
b2.f0.texto: According to the survey, most young people sleep little.
b2.f1.texto: Half of my friends sleep less than six hours.
b2.f2.texto: One in three studies at night.
b2.f4.texto: Very few do sport more than twice a week.
b2.f5.texto: Twenty per cent of the pupils train every day.
b2.f6.texto: Almost everyone prefers the phone to books.
b2.f7.texto: Nobody reads as much as before.
b2.f8.texto: Older people read just as little as young people.
b4.texto:
- **La mayoría de** + group: la mayoría de los jóvenes vive / viven con sus padres.
- **Fractions:** la mitad de, un tercio de, una cuarta parte de + group or amount.
- **Percentages:** put a determiner in front: **el** 20 %, **un** 20 %.
- **Uno de cada tres:** with a group of women, **una** de cada tres.
- **Igual de** + adjective or adverb + **que**: es igual de alto que su padre.
- **Según** + source: según la encuesta.
b4.e0.texto: Most young people live with their parents.
b4.e1.texto: According to the survey, half of the pupils read every day.
b4.e2.texto: My brother is just as tall as my father.
b5.f0.texto: The neighbourhood library keeps a thick silence, full of paper and golden dust.
b5.f1.texto: Behind the counter, Marta notes down the answers to the survey with a short pencil.
b5.f2.texto: According to her numbers, most of the visitors arrive after dinner.
b5.f3.texto: A quarter of them look for old novels with a smell of wood.
b5.f4.texto: Almost everyone speaks in a very low voice, as in a museum.
b5.f5.texto: At the end of the afternoon, Marta adds up the numbers on a yellow sheet.
b5.f6.texto: One in three neighbours reads for more than an hour at night.
b5.f7.texto: Twenty per cent of the readers ask for cookery and travel books.
b5.f8.texto: The number of visits grows each month and little by little fills the empty tables.
b5.f9.texto: Marta closes the notebook with a smile and listens to the calm murmur of the pages.
b6.frase: La mayoría ____ los jóvenes duerme poco.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «La mayoría» is not joined to the group with «que».
b6.o2.refuerzo: «La mayoría en» does not exist in this construction.
b6.pregunta: «La mayoría» asks for a preposition. Which one?
b7.o0.refuerzo: Twenty-five would be «una cuarta parte de» a hundred.
b7.o1.refuerzo: That is it! Half is one of two equal parts.
b7.o2.refuerzo: Thirty-three is roughly «un tercio de» a hundred.
b7.pregunta: How much is «la mitad de» a hundred people?
b8.frase: Muy pocos tienen tiempo libre suficiente
b8.traduccion: Very few have enough free time
b9.frase: Es igual ____ alto que su padre.
b9.o0.refuerzo: «Tan» goes with «como»: «tan alto como su padre».
b9.o1.refuerzo: «Que» goes after the adjective, not before.
b9.pregunta: You compare two equal things. What is missing?
b10.o0.refuerzo: Yes! One out of every three is a third.
b10.o1.refuerzo: Half would be «uno de cada dos».
b10.o2.refuerzo: That reverses the idea: it is one person out of every three.
b10.pregunta: What does «uno de cada tres» mean?
b12.frase: El veinte por ciento de los alumnos ____ cada día.
b12.o0.refuerzo: «Entrenas» is «tú»; here we are talking about other people.
b12.o1.refuerzo: That is it! Plural, like «los alumnos»; the singular is also possible.
b12.o2.refuerzo: «Entreno» is «yo»; here we are talking about other people.
b12.pregunta: It agrees with «los alumnos». Which verb?
p.deporte.consejo: Stress falls on «POR», and the «d» is soft.
p.entrena.consejo: Present of «entrenar», for «él» or «ella». Stress on «TRE».
p.prefieren.consejo: Plural of «prefiere», from «preferir». «ie» forms one stressed sound.
p.mayores.consejo: Plural of «mayor». Here it means older people.
p.apunta.consejo: From «apuntar», to write down. Stress on «PUN».
p.antiguas.consejo: Feminine plural, agreeing with «novelas». The «g» before «u» is hard.
p.bajísima.consejo: Superlative of «baja», with «-ísima». The «j» sounds like «h».
p.suma.consejo: Present of «sumar», for «ella». It means she adds numbers.
p.viajes.consejo: Plural of «viaje». The «v» sounds like «b» and the «j» like «h».
p.visitas.consejo: Plural of «visita». The «v» sounds like «b», and stress is on «SI».
p.aumenta.consejo: Present of «aumentar», for «él» or «ella». Stress on «MEN».
p.páginas.consejo: Plural of «página». The accent on «á» marks stress.
p.entrenan.consejo: Plural of «entrena». They train every day.
